title: MIRAArtifact
description: Defines metadata, cryptographic integrity, retention limits, and verification telemetry for files generated by the Windows workstation and served to Phone 1.

artifact_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier for the artifact.

task_id.description: UUIDv4 of the parent task that generated this file.

user_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying the human user owning this artifact, distinct from device identity.

device_id.description: UUIDv4 of the workstation device that generated the artifact (Windows workstation).

filename.description: Sanitized filename preventing directory traversal or dangerous shell characters.

content_type.description: MIME content type permitted by the MIRA security gateway.

byte_size.description: File payload size in bytes (enforcing 50MB upper limit for mobile transfer).

sha256_hash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest computed at generation time and verified before serving.

storage_path.description: Relative storage path within the isolated container storage volume.

verification_status.description: Outcome of deep payload and integrity validation.

download_url.description: Time-limited, token-authenticated download route for Phone 1.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the artifact was produced on the workstation.
